title: Qiime 2 Workflow - Longitudinal Study
author: Carlotta Catozzi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ucpesvn

steps.title: Import Sequences
steps.instruction: Import Ion Torrent single-end fastq sequences from the directory 'casava-18-single-end-demultiplexed' using the CasavaOneEightSingleLanePerSampleDirFmt format.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime tools import' to create demux-single-endL.qza

steps.title: Visualize Sequence Quality
steps.instruction: Generate a quality plot to inspect the imported sequences.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime demux summarize' on demux-single-endL.qza to produce demux-single-endL.qzv

steps.title: Denoise and Remove Chimeras
steps.instruction: Denoise, dereplicate single-end sequences, and remove chimeras using DADA2.

substeps.instruction: Set trim-left to 19 nucleotides
Set trunc-len based on quality plot (median quality score > 30) and V4 region amplicon length of 245
Run 'qiime dada2 denoise-single' to produce rep-seqs-dada.qza and table-dada.qza

steps.title: Summarize Denoised Data
steps.instruction: Verify the denoising outputs through visualization.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime feature-table tabulate-seqs' on rep-seqs-dada.qza
Run 'qiime feature-table summarize' on table-dada.qza using metadata.tsv

steps.title: Assign Taxonomy
steps.instruction: Classify sequences using the Greengenes 13.8 reference database (99% OTU identity, trimmed to V4 region).

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime feature-classifier classify-sklearn' using classifier_GG99.qza and rep-seqs-dada.qza
Run 'qiime metadata tabulate' on taxonomy-clas-dada.qza to produce taxonomy-clas-dada.qzv

steps.title: Filter Chloroplast Sequences
steps.instruction: Remove chloroplast sequences as potential contaminants from the feature table.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime taxa filter-table' excluding 'Chloroplast' to produce tableGG-noC-dada.qza
Run 'qiime feature-table summarize' on tableGG-noC-dada.qza

steps.title: Collapse and Export Taxonomy Table
steps.instruction: Collapse the taxonomy table to a specific level (e.g., Level 2) and export to TSV.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime taxa collapse' at level 2 to produce tableCOLL-L2.qza
Run 'qiime feature-table relative-frequency' to produce L2_relative.qza
Export L2_relative.qza to directory 'exported-feature-table-L2'
Convert the resulting biom file to TSV using 'biom convert' with header-key taxonomy

steps.title: Generate Phylogenetic Tree
steps.instruction: Create a rooted phylogenetic tree from the representative sequences.

substeps.instruction: Align sequences using 'qiime alignment mafft'
Mask the alignment using 'qiime alignment mask'
Generate an unrooted tree using 'qiime phylogeny fasttree'
Root the tree using 'qiime phylogeny midpoint-root' to produce rooted-tree.qza

steps.title: Calculate Core Metrics
steps.instruction: Compute alpha and beta diversity metrics using a sampling depth of 9500 sequences.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime diversity core-metrics-phylogenetic' using rooted-tree.qza, tableGG-noC-dada.qza, and metadata.tsv

steps.title: Analyze Longitudinal Alpha Diversity
steps.instruction: Calculate pairwise differences for alpha diversity metrics between time points T0 and T5.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences' for the 'shannon' metric using shannon_vector.qza
Run 'qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences' for the 'observed_otus' metric using observed_otus_vector.qza

steps.title: Analyze Longitudinal Beta Diversity
steps.instruction: Calculate pairwise distances for beta diversity between time points T0 and T5.

substeps.instruction: Run 'qiime longitudinal pairwise-distances' using unweighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza
Run 'qiime longitudinal pairwise-distances' using weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza

steps.title: Analyze PCoA Pairwise Differences
steps.instruction: Export PCoA results and calculate pairwise differences for PC1, PC2, and PC3.

substeps.instruction: Export unweighted and weighted UniFrac PCoA results to TSV
Run 'qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences' for PC1, PC2, and PC3 using PCOA_wei_pair.tsv
Run 'qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences' for PC1, PC2, and PC3 using PCOA_unwei_pair.tsv

steps.title: Perform Taxonomic Statistical Analysis in R
steps.instruction: Perform statistical comparisons of taxonomic abundance between time points.

substeps.instruction: For paired data: Load 'coin' package and use 'pairwise.wilcox.test' (paired=T, p.adj='none') for columns 6 to the end of the table, comparing against time (column 5)
For unpaired data: Load 'dunn.test' package and use 'dunn.test' instead of the Wilcoxon test
Export the resulting p-values to a CSV file
